$comment: 语法大厅 G30（V0.9 P3 进阶层，非谓语三课之一）。比喻锚点：伴奏声部：不承担时间戳的那些音。只讲初中层面辨析（接 to do 的动词、tell sb to do、疑问词+to do、目的、too...to/enough to、not to do），不堆砌复杂例外；末尾指向精修层 G46 非谓语综合辨析。暗线：同一动词换身份换规则。全部内容原创。
title: 动词不定式 to do
metaphor: 伴奏声部：不承担时间戳的那些音
ketNote: KET 只在 want to / would like to 这类高频搭配里顺带见到不定式，不单独考。系统的非谓语是初中重头戏——这课为初中/PET 打底，学到就是赚到，不用焦虑。

sections.essence: to + 动词原形＝伴奏声部：不报时间，只补充「要做什么」。
sections.why: 一个英语句子只有一个主奏动词（谓语）负责报时。可一句话常常提到不止一个动作：「我想去游泳」里有「想」和「游」。中文把两个动词直接排排坐；英语不行——报时的位置只有一个，第二个动作要换上伴奏的衣服才准上台，最常见的一套就是 to do：I want to swim. want 报时（主奏），to swim 不承担时间戳（伴奏）。所以不定式天生不变形：不加 -s、不加 -ed，主奏怎么换时态它都纹丝不动。want、hope、decide、plan 这些「指向将来」的动词天生爱接 to do——想做、打算做的事，都还没发生。初中要考的就这几件：谁接 to do、叫某人做某事、疑问词+to do、表目的、too...to。
sections.metaphorStory: 银帆乐队排新曲，主音位置只有一个。键盘手小雨也想进这句旋律，团长拦住她：「一首曲子只能有一个人打拍子报时。你要进来，就当伴奏声部：不打拍子、不报时间，跟着主奏走。」小雨换上绣着 to 的伴奏服站上台：The band decided to join the festival.——decided 是主奏，盖着过去的时间戳；to join 是伴奏，身上干干净净什么戳都没有。团长又演示了伴奏的几种站位：跟在动词后（want to go）、替某人接活（ask sb to do）、缩在疑问词后面打包一个小问题（what to do）、挂在句尾说明目的（got up early to catch the bus）。散场前团长检查着装：「伴奏服里永远穿原形——decided to joined 就是当场穿帮。」

cards.rule: to + 动词原形，永远不变形
cards.detail: 主奏报时，伴奏不带时间戳——不加 -s、-ed、-ing；主奏换时态，它不动。
cards.example: He wants to sleep. / He wanted to sleep.（变的只有主奏）

cards.rule: 爱接 to do 的动词：多半指向将来
cards.detail: want / hope / decide / plan / agree / learn / try / would like——想做打算做的事都还没发生。
cards.example: We plan to visit the museum.

cards.rule: 动词 + 人 + to do：叫某人做某事
cards.detail: tell / ask / want / invite / teach sb to do；否定把 not 放在 to 前——tell sb not to do。
cards.example: The teacher asked us to hand in our homework.

cards.rule: 疑问词 + to do：打包一个小问题
cards.detail: what / how / where / when + to do ＝「该做什么／怎么做」的小盒子。
cards.example: I don't know how to use this app.

cards.detail: 挂在句尾（或提到句首）说明做某事的目的——中文的「为了」常常就藏在这个 to 里。
cards.example: She got up early to catch the first bus.

cards.detail: too + 形容词 + to do＝太……而不能（否定藏在结构里）；形容词 + enough to do＝足够……能。
cards.example: The box is too heavy to carry. / He is old enough to go to school alone.

basic.en: I want to be a music teacher.
basic.cn: 我想当一名音乐老师。（want 报时，to be 伴奏）

basic.en: She hopes to see the sea some day.
basic.cn: 她希望有一天能看到大海。

basic.en: He is learning to swim this summer.
Would you like to have some tea?

mid.en: The teacher told us to keep quiet.
mid.cn: 老师叫我们保持安静。（tell sb to do）

mid.en: I don't know what to say.
mid.cn: 我不知道该说什么。（疑问词 + to do）

mid.en: She went to the shop to buy some milk.
mid.cn: 她去商店买牛奶。（to buy 表目的）

mid.en: It's time to go to bed.
My parents agreed to take me to the concert.
mid.cn: 父母同意带我去音乐会。

trap.en: The doctor told me not to drink cold water.
trap.note: 不定式的否定是 not to do——not 站在 to 前面。

trap.en: I have a lot of homework to do tonight.
trap.cn: 今晚我有很多作业要做。
trap.note: to do 跟在名词后当小尾巴——「有作业要做」。

trap.en: The math problem is too hard to work out.
trap.cn: 这道数学题难得做不出来。
trap.note: too...to 自带否定味——后面不再加 not。

trap.en: Please tell me when to start.
trap.cn: 请告诉我什么时候开始。
trap.note: 疑问词 + to do 是打包的小问题＝when I should start。

trap.en: He stopped to drink some water.
trap.note: stop to do 是「停下来去做」——和 stop doing（停止做）不同，G31 细讲。

trap.en: It's important for young players to practise every day.
trap.cn: 对小乐手来说，每天练习很重要。
trap.note: for + 人 给伴奏声部指定演奏者。

redBlack.bad: He stopped to talk in class.（想说：他不再上课讲话了）
redBlack.why: stop to do 是「停下手头的事、专门去讲话」——想夸他改掉毛病，反而说成他停课聊天，意思全反。

redBlack.bad: She is too tired to not walk on.（想说：累得走不动了）
redBlack.good: She is too tired to walk on.
redBlack.why: too...to 自带「不能」——再塞个 not 变成绕口令，她到底走不走没人听得懂。

redBlack.bad: I want go to the zoo.
redBlack.good: I want to go to the zoo.
redBlack.why: want 后面的动作要穿伴奏服 to——两个动词不能光着排排坐。

redBlack.bad: He decided to went home early.
redBlack.good: He decided to go home early.
redBlack.why: 时间戳已由 decided 盖过——伴奏声部永远穿原形。

redBlack.bad: She asked me to helped her.
redBlack.good: She asked me to help her.
redBlack.why: to 后面只能是原形——helped 把时间戳偷偷带上了台。

redBlack.bad: I don't know what to do it.
redBlack.good: I don't know what to do.
redBlack.why: what 本身就是 do 的对象——再加 it 就重复占座了。

redBlack.bad: It's time to going to bed.
redBlack.good: It's time to go to bed.

redBlack.bad: He gets up early to catches the bus.
redBlack.good: He gets up early to catch the bus.
redBlack.why: 表目的的 to do 也不变形——报时的是 gets up，不是 catch。

redBlack.bad: My dream is become a pilot.
redBlack.good: My dream is to become a pilot.
redBlack.why: is 后面的动作要穿 to 才能当表语——光放原形不行。

redBlack.bad: The box is too heavy to carry it.
redBlack.good: The box is too heavy to carry.
redBlack.why: too...to 结构里，箱子本来就是 carry 的对象——再补 it 画蛇添足。

redBlack.bad: To really understand music, listen every day.（有人说 to 和动词之间绝不能插词）
redBlack.good: to really understand 完全可以。
redBlack.why: 「分裂不定式」在现代英语早已通行——不挡意思，考试不设坑。

redBlack.bad: — Would you like to come? — Yes, I'd love to.（有人觉得 to 后面必须补动词）
redBlack.good: I'd love to. 挂着 to 收尾就行。
redBlack.why: 承前省略动词、留个 to 是地道说法——大家都知道省的是 come。

contrast.cn: 我想去游泳。（两个动词排排坐）
contrast.diff: 中文动词能连着排；英语一句只有一个主奏报时，第二个动作要穿 to 当伴奏。

contrast.cn: 他决定明天出发。（「决定」「出发」都不变形）
contrast.diff: 英语只在主奏 decided 上盖时间戳；伴奏 to leave 永远原形。

contrast.en: I don't know what to say.
contrast.diff: 英语把「该说什么」打包成疑问词 + to do 的小盒子，整个当宾语用。

contrast.cn: 她早起是为了赶头班车。（「为了」是单独的词）
contrast.en: She got up early to catch the first bus.
contrast.diff: 英语的「为了」常常就藏在 to 里——不用再加别的词。

contrast.cn: 这箱子太重，搬不动。（两个短句）
contrast.en: The box is too heavy to carry.
contrast.diff: too...to 一个结构装下「太……」和「不能」两层意思——否定藏在结构里。

quickJudge.mnemonic: 一句一个主奏报时；第二个动作穿 to 上台；to 后永远原形；否定 not 站 to 前。
steps: 找主奏：句子里报时的动词是谁？时间戳全归它。
第二个动作要出场？want / hope / decide / plan 这类指向将来的动词 → 接 to do。
「叫谁做」？动词 + 人 + to do（tell / ask / invite sb to do）。
「该做什么／怎么做」？疑问词 + to do 打包成小盒子。
说目的（为了……）→ 句尾挂 to do。
自查两件事：to 后面是不是干净的原形？否定的 not 是不是站在 to 前面？

parentScript.script: 「宝贝，英语一句话只有一个动词能当主唱、报时间；第二个动作要穿一件叫 to 的伴奏服才能上台。咱们玩『主唱和伴奏』：我说中文『我想去公园』，你翻成英语，再告诉我谁是主唱（want，管报时）、谁是伴奏（to go，不报时）。我不懂英语也能当评委，就听两件事：第二个动作前面有没有 to 的音；to 后面的词干不干净——不能带 -ed、-s 的尾巴。再玩『为了』：你说一件今天做的事加上它的目的，比如 I got up early to catch the school bus——我一听到 to，就知道后面是目的。说错了不批评，重说一遍就行。」
questions: 「我想去游泳」里谁报时间？「游」为什么不用变形？
不定式的否定 not 应该站在哪儿？
I don't know what to do. 里的 what to do 打包的是哪个小问题？

sections.echo: 同一个动词，站上主奏位就要报时变形（plays / played），换上 to 的伴奏服就冻结成原形——身份一换，规则全换，像同一个乐手换了乐器就得守另一套指法。这是非谓语家族的第一张脸：G31 的 doing 把动作打包成东西，G32 的 -ing/-ed 给动作当形容词，三张脸各有各的规矩，到精修层 G46 会合到一起做总对比。规律可以先记一半：不当主奏的动词，一律不报时——英语把「报时权」看得比什么都紧，一句话只发一张报时执照。

memoryCard.alt: G30 记忆卡：一句只有一个主奏报时，第二个动作穿 to 当伴奏且永远原形；五种站位（动词后/tell sb to do/疑问词后/表目的/名词小尾巴）；否定 not to do；too...to 与 enough to；警示 want go、to went、to going、told me don't。

stages.name: 认一认 · 主奏与伴奏

questions.q: 不定式的样子是？
questions.explain: 伴奏服里永远穿原形。

questions.q: I want to swim. 谁在报时间？
questions.explain: 时间戳全在主奏 want 身上。

questions.q: 不定式会跟着时态变形吗？
questions.explain: He wanted to sleep.——变的只有 want。

questions.q: 不定式的否定形式是？
questions.explain: not 站在 to 前面——tell sb not to do。

questions.q: 下面哪个动词后面爱接 to do？
questions.explain: want 指向将来接 to do；enjoy/finish 接 doing（G31 讲）。

questions.q: hope 后面接？
questions.explain: 希望做的事还没发生——to do。

questions.q: decide 后面接？
questions.explain: 决定要做的事指向将来——to do。

questions.q: tell sb ___ sth（叫某人做某事），空格填？
questions.explain: 动词 + 人 + to do。

questions.q: 疑问词（what / how / when）后面打包接？
questions.explain: what to do＝「该做什么」的小盒子。

questions.q: She got up early to catch the bus. 里 to catch 表示？
questions.explain: 「为了」就藏在这个 to 里。

questions.q: too heavy to carry 的意思是？
questions.explain: too...to 自带「不能」——否定藏在结构里。

questions.q: old enough to go to school 的意思是？
questions.explain: enough to＝足够……能。

questions.q: It's time ___ to bed. 空格填？
questions.explain: It's time to do——该做某事了。

questions.q: Would you like ___ some tea?
questions.explain: would like 接 to do。

questions.q: I have a lot of homework ___ tonight.
questions.explain: to do 当名词的小尾巴——「有作业要做」。

questions.q: learn 后面接？
questions.explain: 学着去做——learn to do。

stages.name: 选一选 · 给伴奏穿衣

questions.q: I want ___ a singer when I grow up.
questions.explain: want + to do——伴奏穿 to。

questions.q: She hopes ___ the sea some day.
questions.explain: hope + to do。

questions.q: We decided ___ home on foot.
questions.explain: decide + to do。

questions.q: The teacher told us ___ quiet.
questions.explain: tell sb to do。

questions.q: My parents agreed ___ me to the concert.
questions.explain: agree + to do。

questions.q: I don't know what ___ next.
questions.explain: 疑问词 + to do。

questions.q: She went to the shop ___ some milk.
questions.explain: 表目的——to buy。

questions.q: He is learning ___ the drum.
questions.explain: learn to do。

questions.q: The doctor told me ___ cold water.
questions.explain: 否定的 not 站在 to 前面。

questions.q: Please tell me when ___.
questions.explain: when to start＝什么时候开始。

questions.q: It's important for us ___ every day.
questions.explain: for us 指定演奏者，后面接 to do。

questions.q: The box is too heavy ___.
questions.explain: too...to do——否定藏在结构里。

questions.q: He is old enough ___ to school alone.
questions.explain: enough + to do。

questions.q: Would you like ___ with us?
questions.explain: would like + to do。

questions.q: I got up early ___ the first bus.
questions.explain: 表目的——to catch。

questions.q: My dream is ___ a pilot.
questions.explain: is 后面的动作穿 to 当表语。

stages.name: 改一改 · 穿帮的伴奏

questions.q: 哪一句穿对了伴奏服？（我想回家）
questions.explain: want + to + 原形——三件缺一不可。

questions.q: 哪一句穿对了？（他决定早点出发）
questions.explain: to 后面永远原形 leave。

questions.q: 哪一句穿对了？（她叫我帮忙）
options: She asked me to help her.
She asked me to helped her.
questions.explain: ask sb to do——to help。

questions.q: 哪一句穿对了？（我不知道该做什么）
options: I don't know what to do.
I don't know what to do it.
I don't know to do what.
questions.explain: what 就是 do 的对象——不再补 it。

questions.q: 哪一句穿对了？（该睡觉了）
options: It's time to go to bed.
It's time to going to bed.
questions.explain: to + 原形 go。

questions.q: 哪一句穿对了？（他早起为了赶公交）
options: He gets up early to catch the bus.
He gets up early to catches the bus.
He gets up early for catch the bus.
questions.explain: 表目的用 to do——不变形，也不说 for catch。

questions.q: 哪一句穿对了？（我的梦想是当飞行员）
options: My dream is to become a pilot.
My dream is become a pilot.
My dream is to became a pilot.
questions.explain: 表语位置的动作穿 to + 原形。

questions.q: 哪一句穿对了？（箱子太重搬不动）
options: The box is too heavy to carry.
The box is too heavy to carry it.
The box is too heavy for carry.
questions.explain: too...to 里箱子就是 carry 的对象——it 多余。

questions.q: 哪一句穿对了？（医生叫我别喝冷水）
options: The doctor told me not to drink cold water.
The doctor told me don't drink cold water.
The doctor told me to no drink cold water.
questions.explain: 叫某人别做——not to do。

questions.q: 哪一句穿对了？（请告诉我何时开始）
options: Please tell me when to start.
Please tell me when to starting.
questions.explain: 疑问词 + to + 原形。

questions.q: 哪一句穿对了？（今晚有很多作业要做）
options: I have a lot of homework to do tonight.
I have a lot of homework doing tonight.
I have a lot of homework to does tonight.
questions.explain: homework to do——名词的小尾巴用 to + 原形。

questions.q: 哪一句穿对了？（他停下来喝了口水）
options: He stopped to drink some water.
He stopped to drank some water.
questions.explain: 停下来去喝水——stop to do，to 后原形。

questions.q: 哪一句穿对了？（她够大了，能自己回家）
options: She is old enough to go home alone.
She is enough old to go home alone.
She is old enough going home alone.
questions.explain: 形容词 + enough + to do——enough 站在形容词后面。

questions.q: 哪一句穿对了？（你想加入我们乐队吗）
options: Would you like to join our band?
Would you like join our band?
Would you like to joining our band?
questions.explain: would like + to + 原形。

questions.q: 哪一句穿对了？（对我们来说学好中文很重要）
options: It's important for us to learn Chinese well.
It's important for us learn Chinese well.
It's important of us to learn Chinese well.
questions.explain: It's + 形容词 + for sb + to do。

questions.q: 哪一句穿对了？（我们同意再试一次）
questions.explain: agree + to do，to 后原形 try。

questions.q: He wanted ___ out, but Mum told him ___ at home.
questions.explain: want to do；tell sb to do——两件伴奏服。

questions.q: I stopped ___ a rest because I was too tired ___ on.
questions.explain: 停下来去休息 stop to do；too...to 累得走不动。

questions.q: — I don't know how ___ this word. — Ask the teacher ___ you.
questions.explain: how to spell 打包小问题；ask sb to do。

questions.q: She was happy ___ the good news, and she decided ___ her grandma at once.
questions.explain: happy to hear；decide to do。

questions.q: We got to the station early ___ the train, but it was too crowded ___ on.
questions.explain: 表目的 to catch；too...to get on 挤得上不去。

questions.q: The teacher asked us ___ in groups and told us ___ loudly.
questions.explain: ask sb to do；否定 not to talk。

questions.q: Do you know where ___ tickets? I'd like ___ two.
questions.explain: where to buy 打包；would like to do。

questions.q: He's too young ___ the film, but he's old enough ___ to the park alone.
questions.explain: too...to 与 enough to 都接 to do。

questions.q: My uncle gets up at five every day ___ his shop on time.
questions.explain: 表目的——to open；报时的是 gets up。

questions.q: — What made you decide ___ the singing club? — I hope ___ braver on stage.
questions.explain: decide to do；hope to do。

questions.q: There is nothing ___ about — the test is easy ___.
questions.explain: nothing to worry about；easy to pass。

questions.q: The girl was afraid ___ in front of people, so her mother encouraged her ___ it a try.
questions.explain: afraid to do；encourage sb to do。

questions.q: Would you like ___ us? We plan ___ a short play.
questions.explain: would like to do；plan to do。

questions.q: I opened the window ___ some fresh air in.
questions.explain: 开窗的目的——to let air in。

questions.q: He was the first ___ at school and the last ___.
questions.explain: the first/last + to do——固定站位。

questions.q: 大考：He turned on the light ___ his key, asked his sister ___ him, and promised ___ more careful next time.
options: to look for / to help / to be
to look for / to help / being
questions.explain: 三件伴奏服一次穿齐：目的 to look for、ask sb to do、promise to be。

detective.sentence: I want go to the bookshop after school.
detective.fixed: I want to go to the bookshop after school.
detective.clue: want 后的动作要穿伴奏服 to——两个动词不能光着排排坐。

detective.sentence: She decided to stayed at home.
detective.fixed: She decided to stay at home.
detective.clue: 时间戳已由 decided 盖过——to 后面永远原形。

detective.sentence: The teacher told us don't be late.
detective.fixed: The teacher told us not to be late.
detective.clue: 「叫某人别做」用 not to do——not 站在 to 前面。

detective.sentence: I don't know how to using this camera.
detective.fixed: I don't know how to use this camera.
detective.clue: 疑问词 + to + 原形——不是 -ing。

detective.sentence: He ran fast for catch the early bus.
detective.fixed: He ran fast to catch the early bus.
detective.clue: 表目的用 to do——for catch 是中式拼装。

detective.sentence: The soup is too hot to drink it.
detective.fixed: The soup is too hot to drink.
detective.clue: too...to 里 soup 本来就是 drink 的对象——it 多余。

detective.sentence: My job today is water the flowers.
detective.fixed: My job today is to water the flowers.
detective.clue: is 后面的动作要穿 to 当表语——光放原形不行。
